verdict.rationale: The only evidence of action-item extraction with task creation appears among Granola API use cases, which describe what a developer could build. That is a developer building block, not a native feature that extracts action items with owners and collects them for tracking. A PM in the community reported that action items slipped through and built their own kanban app as a workaround. A user-side workaround earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
